proposal.summary: FortiAnalyzer versions 7.2.0–7.2.1, 7.0.0–7.0.4, and 6.4.0–6.4.10 expose a client machine password in plaintext in a heartbeat response when a log-fetch request is made, allowing a remote authenticated attacker to read it.
proposal.cwe_quote: may allow a remote authenticated  attacker to read the client machine password in plain text in a heartbeat response when a log-fetch request is made from the FortiAnalyzer

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the issue on the stated FortiAnalyzer versions, identify the API/heartbeat response field leaking the password, and prepare a patch or configuration mitigation to prevent plaintext password disclosure; notify affected customers and advise authentication credential rotation.
